Greenvale tileset 緑の谷 and Ashkara 砂の国

4900 hand-written SVG tiles in round-3 design B (seamless watercolour terrain, crisp 3/4-view props with soft painted shading and a soft drop shadow): the common set plus Sunny Meadows, Old Oak Wood (step 2), Bamboo Valley and Mirror Lake (step 3), Rice Terraces and Mossy Ruins (step 4), Firefly Marsh and Misty Highlands (step 5), plus the first set of the second region, the desert Ashkara (tileset/desert-common.html, 359 tiles, design in maps/DESERT.md). Base cell 64×64, tall props 64×128, large objects 128×128. Spec in tiles/TILESET.md.

Tile sets

One page per set; each lists every tile by category with the autotile sets grouped by name. The pages load the SVG files by relative path, so keep the layout tileset-gallery.html, tileset/, tiles/greenvale/ together when hosting.

Common 537

Shared by the whole region: seamless ground families, the autotile sets (water shore, deep water, dirt, sand, cliff, forest), trees, rocks, fences and hedges, props, interest objects and overlays.

Ashkara: Desert common 359

Step 1 of the second region, the desert Ashkara (design in maps/DESERT.md).

Sunny Meadows 318

Wildflower carpets and patch autotiles, rolling hills, farm fields with crops, farm fences and stone walls, windmill, barn, beehives, scarecrows, picnic, orchard and sunflowers, the lone blossom tree with petal drift, and a lily pond.

Old Oak Wood 360

Forest-floor variants (moss, roots, litter, ferns, glow), oaks of every age, the sacred oak and its hollow-trunk door, root arches, fungi and glowing mushrooms, fallen logs, shrine stones and a stone circle, a woodcutter camp, owls and webs, plus the meadow to forest blends.

Bamboo Valley 443

Green, golden, black and young bamboo (clumps, bushes, stands, three tree-line autotiles), a clear stream autotile with pebbly banks that flows east, stepping stones, rapids, koi, plank bridges and an arched bridge, a waterfall, thatched huts and the hut gate, a tea house, stone lanterns, shishi-odoshi and tsukubai, bamboo fences and screens, valley mist and light shafts.

Mirror Lake 460

Open water with reflections and ripples, lily pads and lotus in several states, reeds and cattails, a pebble-beach shoreline autotile, reflective deep water, islets and island autotile, lily beds, connecting jetties, rowboats and a ferry, the vermilion torii standing in the water with its reflection, boathouse gate, shrine islet, market boat, fishing nets, herons and ducks, willows, and evening sparkle.

Rice Terraces 576

Stepped paddy terraces, earth banks, channels and a waterwheel.

Mossy Ruins 435

Moss-covered shrine ruins with flagstone, broken torii and wisps.

Firefly Marsh 736

The marsh at dusk.

Misty Highlands 676

Ochre pasture, heather, gorse, moor, scree and rock slab ground (with ramps from the marsh and the ruins); autotiles for ochre, heather and scree patches, gorse thickets, grey ridges with height, mountain streams and a ravine; a rope bridge, prayer-flag lines, dry-stone walls and rope fences; wind-bent pines, rowan, birch, standing stones, stone circles, cairns, boulders, mountain shrines and lanterns, waterfalls, shepherd huts, goat and bird decals, and the stone mountain gate (closed, open) that leads out of Greenvale; drifting and low mist, rising ravine mist and cloud shadows.

Sample patches

Composed at random from the tiles: random grass variants side by side with no seams, ponds and lakes (shore set, deep set, lily beds), cliffs, tree lines, fenced fields, plus props and fog. Reroll for a new layout.

Common

Sub-areas

Each sub-area composed from its own sets (with common props where useful). The three blends: the meadow to forest edge, the Bamboo Valley stream widening through the stream-mouth autotiles into Mirror Lake, and the Mirror Lake shore climbing through earth banks, paddy terraces and mossy stone terraces into the Mossy Ruins platform, and, from step 5, Firefly Marsh at dusk, the Misty Highlands, and the ruins and marsh climbing into the highlands.

Ashkara desert patch

An oasis pool with date palms, a camp and caravan, a bazaar stall, a sphinx and pylon gate on a sandstone plateau, dune ridges, a hardpan flat and a mud-brick wall, composed from the desert common set only. Reroll for a new layout.

Greenvale overview

A 16×24 strip walking north through all eight sub-areas, each in its own tiles: Sunny Meadows, Old Oak Wood (floor-patch blend), Bamboo Valley with its stream running into Mirror Lake, the Rice Terraces climbing through paddy and mossy terraces into the Mossy Ruins, dusk-patch into Firefly Marsh, and ochre patches rising into the Misty Highlands under the stone mountain gate.
